name: Restaurants & hospitality
problem: Bookings and enquiries come in while the kitchen is busy, and nobody can get to the phone.
fix: The AI voice receptionist answers, takes the booking and texts you the details.

name: Estate agents & property
problem: Viewing requests and valuations go to whichever agent replies first.
fix: Speed-to-lead replies to every enquiry within a minute and books the viewing straight into your diary.

name: Car dealers
problem: Finance and test-drive enquiries go cold overnight.
fix: Speed-to-lead follows up every one in minutes, and the CRM keeps the chase going.

name: Garages & mechanics
problem: The phone rings while you’re under a car, and the caller books in somewhere else.
fix: The voice receptionist answers, books the MOT or service, and sends the confirmation and a reminder.

name: Trades & construction
problem: Quotes wait until the evening, because you’re on site all day.
fix: Quote automation turns the enquiry into a draft quote, ready for you to check and send.

name: Clinics & aesthetics
problem: Appointment requests and questions arrive after hours.
fix: The website assistant answers questions on the spot, and the voice receptionist takes the calls.

name: Retail & boutiques
problem: Customers buy once and forget you, and happy ones rarely leave a review.
fix: Win-back campaigns bring them back, and the review engine asks at the right moment.

name: Golf & leisure clubs
problem: Visitor calls, tee times and membership enquiries ring out at busy times.
fix: The voice receptionist answers with your tee times, prices and membership details.
